name: Scholarmancy
subtitle: Grades and missing work alerts
promotionalText: See every class, grade and missing assignment from Canvas, Skyward or Aeries in one place. Your school password stays on your phone.
description:
Scholarmancy shows you where your student stands in every class, without signing in to the school portal each time.

Connect your school's Canvas, Skyward or Aeries account on your phone. Scholarmancy reads the grades, assignments and class documents your school already posts and puts them in one place.

WHAT YOU SEE
• Grades: the current grade in every class, with an overall view.
• Assignments: what is coming up, what is missing and what is past.
• Class documents: the files and handouts your teachers post, next to the class they belong to.
• Alerts: missing work, grade changes and work due soon, in one inbox.

HOW YOU HEAR ABOUT IT
• Push notifications.
• A daily or weekly email digest.
• Text message alerts, if you opt in.
• Quiet hours, so alerts wait until you want them.

FOR THE FAMILY
• Invite a co-parent or guardian to follow the same student.
• Each adult signs in with their own account.

YOUR SCHOOL PASSWORD STAYS ON YOUR PHONE
Your school portal username and password are stored only in your phone's Keychain. They are never sent to Scholarmancy servers. The app signs in to the portal on your phone and sends only the school data it needs (grades, assignments and class documents) to show it back to you and to send your alerts. You can delete your account and its data in the app at any time.

SUPPORTED SCHOOL PORTALS
• Canvas
• Skyward Family Access
• Aeries Parent Portal

Scholarmancy is free for one student. Following more students, and some alert options, need a paid plan.

Scholarmancy is an independent app. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Instructure, Skyward or Aeries Software.
